---
title: NADABAS 6.02.011
---

This Excel add-in update follows the two-file VBA installation procedure used
in 6.02.005. Extract both files to the same folder, open
`NADABAS.6.02.011.xlsm` and select **Install as add-in**. Restart Excel and
confirm that **About** shows **6.02.011**. The installed file is `NADABAS.xlam`
in Excel's per-user add-in folder.

## Changes

- Fix Access workbook-ID migration for older databases.
- Preserve the selected language when opening the language dialog.
- Add a setting to show or hide the Exchange tools in the ribbon.
- Validate key family dimension lengths before creating database structures.
- Improve database snapshot and batch error reporting.
- Use Excel to deactivate known NADABAS startup loaders when installing the
  VBA add-in. Keep the legacy file deletion restricted to Excel's add-in folder.
